Off the Fire

Menu & Packages

Every order is roasted to order. Pricing is quoted per event based on size, guest count, and add-ons.

Classic Whole Lechon

Serves 15–20

The centerpiece. Slow-roasted whole, seasoned overnight, carved tableside with crackling skin on the side.

Lechon Belly Roll

Serves 6–8

Boneless, rolled, and roasted for smaller gatherings — all the crackle, none of the carving.

Fiesta Package

Serves 25–30

Whole lechon plus rice, atchara, and house lechon sauce — built for weddings and big fiestas.

Sides & Add-Ons

A la carte

Extra crackling, house lechon sauce, garlic rice, atchara, and kinilaw — round out the table.

Solo Pack

Serves 1

Lechon, rice, house sauce, and a side of kinilaw packed to go — a personal-size plate for lunch on the move.

Whole lechon orders need advance notice — call early to lock in your event date.

How It's Done

From Spit to Table

01

Seasoned Overnight

Garlic, lemongrass, and spice, rested a full day.

02

Mounted on the Spit

Hand-tied and balanced for an even, steady turn.

03

Turned on the Rotisserie

Even, gas-fired heat until the skin blisters and crackles.

04

Rested & Carved

A short rest to lock in the juices, then carved to order.
